question: Can a nonparametric nearest-neighbor outcome distribution conditioned jointly on market and frozen-out-of-time DC probabilities change fixed-coverage 1X2 accuracy relative to market on the same K League 1 opportunities?
scope: exploratory; 2024/2025 samples reused repeatedly; not independent/blind; no production use

source.source_counts: 455 rows: 228 2024 OOF / 227 2025 evaluation, as reported by input manifest; exact row eligibility audited after preregistration
source.restrictions: same archived K League 1 full-game 1X2 prices and results; no contemporaneous receipt/price execution verification; no actual tipster or frozen operating selection

model: nearest neighbors in six raw probabilities [market home,draw,away, DC home,draw,away], squared Euclidean metric, uniform weights; class probability (neighbor class count + 1)/(k + 3), no market blend or team labels; order equal distances by id
hypothesis: similar historical market-and-team forecast configurations can have different class frequencies than the market argmax; local empirical neighbors may alter choice
validation_selection: mean multiclass logloss on all eligible validation fixtures; lower k wins ties within 1e-12; candidate must be selected before test; 3-way search disclosed

splits.test: 2025-01-01 <= day < 2026-01-01; refit selected k once using all eligible 2024 rows; each training row day <= first test day minus 7 days
splits.timing: all input DC predictions must have dc_training_cutoff <= their own day minus 7 days; older results assumed available +7 calendar days, not independently timestamped; 2025 DC inputs may use earlier 2025 results, despite fixed neighbor bank

eligibility: exact expected source 455 unique ids; fail closed on missing date, id, complete 3-vector, price, valid label or OOF cutoff; never filter by predicted edge; report input and excluded counts separately. Do not use target score/outcome as feature or to join identities.
picks: argmax; exact ties smallest side index, no abstention, coverage 100% on accepted source cohort
controls: same historical DC probability and prices
metrics: same day close maximum drawdown and monthly hypothetical unit P&L
observed-week paired bootstrap 5000 seed 20261102: accuracy and ROI difference vs market, descriptive
bias: prices archive, actual historical quote availability/execution/independent receipt not certified; same-set DC and result provenance inherited; 2025 repeatedly inspected; n<300; no wallet stop-loss simulation
falsification: future/target poison does not alter corresponding prediction
independent Decimal settlement of saved predictions
constraints: no network at execution; no training on 2025 targets; no deploying, operating changes, betting, or merge
